**Finding: deviation (LICENSE — Licence grant scope)**

- **§ 2(a) grant (p0022)** licenses only "Client" — no affiliates, no contractors acting on our behalf, and no path to add them. § 2(b)(ii) permits adding *sites* on written notice, not entities, so the clause does not even reach the fallback ("affiliates covered on written notice").
- **§ 15 (p0080)** allows consent-free assignment only to "a financially responsible affiliate," leaving an M&A successor dependent on TrueLink's approval — short of the fallback's successor-transferability requirement.
- Not walk-away: the licence is not revocable at will (§ 2(c) runs to termination; triggers in § 13/§ 14 are breach- or non-renewal-based), and there is no suspension right.

**Redline (validated ok:true)** — two minimal inserts: adds "its affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf" to the grant, and a successor-in-interest carve-out to the assignment clause, reaching the preferred position on both material terms.
